page.layout: One printed page: a title block at the top, a central engraving (woodcut vignette) with no text inside it, and a short imprint below the engraving. Mirrored lines below the engraving are show-through and are left out.
page.notes: The page is a title page. The central engraving is a vignette with no legible text. The two lines at the top are faint and largely unreadable. The lines below the engraving appear reversed, which indicates show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
